why: a pull-side view of the feedback channel read with `wait_next(executor, timeout)`. RFC-0021's shape: the blocking form takes the executor and drives it. Its async `recv()` and the `stream` feature's `Stream` impl were retired by phase-521 (RFC-0113 D7): they completed only while something else spun the executor. rclcpp_action delivers feedback only through `SendGoalOptions::feedback_callback`; see `cpp:ActionClient::feedback_stream`.
